# flutter_chat_kit

Backend-agnostic chat kit: models, SQLite cache, outbox, controllers, customizable UI.

- Import: `package:flutter_chat_kit/flutter_chat_kit.dart`
- App implements ChatSource (fetch rooms/messages, events stream, send, edit, delete, markRead), ChatUploader, ChatUserResolver
- Kit owns Drift cache (one DB per user), per-room sync, keyset pagination, offline outbox with retry
- ChatKit root + ChatKitScope; InboxController, ChatRoomController, ComposerController (ChangeNotifier, no Riverpod)
- ChatRoomView / InboxView; every piece replaceable via ChatBuilders / InboxBuilders; CustomMessage + customBuilders for app types (e.g. offer)
- ChatTheme (ThemeExtension), ChatConfig, ChatStrings (app passes strings), ChatFormatters
- No firebase, supabase, dio, riverpod, slang in lib/
- Build order: spec/tasks/README.md
